items.label: ENHANCES THE BEAUTY OF THE WOOD
items.value: Teak Oil restores the beauty of grey, old and weathered teak furniture to give a long-lasting, golden-brown natural finish.

items.label: PROVIDES PROTECTION
items.value: Our high-quality teak oil will protect your indoor and outdoor wooden products from sun rays and help prevent further drying, warping, and splitting. It can be used on teak as well as other hardwoods and exotic woods.

items.label: SEAL & RESTORES
items.value: Use this wood oil to seal unfinished or bare teak and maintain it on an ongoing basis. Ideal for garden furniture, the oil creates a water-resistant seal and replaces oils lost through weathering.

items.label: PREMIUM NATURAL FORMULA
items.value: Furniture Clinic's Teak Oil is a clear oil that is formulated using a traditional recipe of pure, high-quality Tung and Linseed Oil. This safe and non-toxic oil dries to a natural matte finish.

items.label: EASY TO APPLY
items.value: Our Teak Oil is quick drying and easy to use. Simply apply the oil to a lint free cloth and rub into the wood to see instant results. Leave for a few minutes then wipe off any excess.

items.label: SATISFACTION GUARANTEED
items.value: Our experts are here if you have questions before purchasing and, if after purchasing, you are not satisfied with the results (we expect you will be) we offer a money back guarantee.
